args.lesson: Observed: the PCS-Tender portal root returns a login page (HTTP 200) and its directly linked public Opportunities listing redirects the FETCH client to a browser-not-supported page, so tender-pack requirements for 105246-2026 were not readable; no worksheet was written. Worked: checking the existing iwms-checklist first (it already covers every notice-stated fact) and stopping at the first access limit within two pages. Limit: the redirect shows a client limitation, not that documents are restricted for real browsers. Next time: do not queue document-dependent deliverables for Jaggaer-hosted portals without a real browser capability; reconsider on an authorized browser, a direct public document URL in a new notice release, or an inbound supplier supplying pasted excerpts.
